title: PROP-077 Q_OP answers + ship Part B (integrity clone-source-of-truth) + light-touch decider audit for the same clone-source rule
background:
Tinker's PROP-077 (DIRECTIVE-20260603-002 implementation) shipped Part A (recent-commit pre-push guard in workspace-sync.md) and held Part B for operator review. PROP-077's H5 root-cause discovery was that the 2026-06-03T01:30Z open-issues.json revert was committed by INTEGRITY, not workspace-sync — the actual fix is to force integrity to read/write monitor/decisions/* from its clone, never from FUSE.

Operator has reviewed PROP-077's 4 Q_OPs and answers all 4 in this directive. Tinker should consume these answers, ship Part B as a follow-up implementation, and bundle the light-touch decider audit (Q_OP_4 scope narrowed to decider only).

Q_OP_1_approve_part_b.rationale: Part B is the actual fix per the H5 root cause. Without it, integrity keeps reading/writing monitor/decisions/* from FUSE; recurrence is high-probability. Decider's auto-heal is the safety net but took 2h on 2026-06-03 and is heuristic-based.

Q_OP_2_revert_dome_mirror_cron_to_00.rationale: Hold off on cron revert until Part B has been live for 2-3 days and proven stable. The :30 offset costs nothing operationally and adds defense-in-depth. Tinker should flag this Q_OP as 're-evaluate 2026-06-06 or later' in the proposal's post-deployment plan.

Q_OP_3_tune_recent_commit_window.rationale: Tinker's recommended default is correctly conservative. Cost of false-skip is low (next workspace-sync cycle catches up); cost of false-allow is the revert incident class. 300s balances correctly. Do not retune in this directive.

Q_OP_4_symmetric_guards_other_writers.answer: NO heavy guards. YES light-touch audit, scope narrowed to DECIDER ONLY (analyst / analyst-baby / tinker held back).
Q_OP_4_symmetric_guards_other_writers.rationale: The heavy workspace-sync-style 27-LOC guard would bloat prompts across N writers. The actual fix is lighter: a one-line rule in each writer's prompt saying 'clone is source-of-truth for monitor/decisions/* and monitor/analyst/* — never read or write FUSE for these files.' Decider is the highest-risk single writer (most prolific state writer + we just saw Mech-A bypass evidence that close-paths drift). If audit reveals decider's prompt already has this rule explicitly, no edit needed. If missing, add a one-liner. Tinker should NOT pre-emptively edit analyst/analyst-baby/tinker prompts in this run — wait for evidence of recurrence on those surfaces before expanding scope.

requested_work: Step 1 — Author monitor/tinker/proposals/PROP-077-rev2-part-b-integrity-clone-source-of-truth.json (or whatever PROP-NNN tinker prefers for the follow-up). Specify the integrity prompt edits exactly: Section 7h PROLOGUE block + Section 7a.5 same treatment + intro one-line note per PROP-077 success_criteria_part_B M1-M3. Operator pre-approves the design directions documented in PROP-077's part_b spec; tinker may adopt them verbatim or refine if a clearer wording surfaces.

Step 2 — Self-apply Part B per the PROP-070/072/073/PROP-076/077-Part-A pattern: edit monitor/prompts/structure-integrity.md to add the clone-source-of-truth rule for monitor/decisions/* and any monitor/analyst/* writes the integrity prompt touches. Verify with the PROP file's M1-M3 success-criteria pattern + M4 next-3-commits-diff-line-count canary plan.

Step 3 — DECIDER AUDIT (Q_OP_4 narrowed scope): grep monitor/prompts/decider.md AND monitor/prompts/reference/decider-*.md for explicit clone-source-of-truth language for monitor/decisions/* and monitor/analyst/*. Report findings in the PROP file:
  (a) If the rule is already present and explicit, document the search-match line(s) and conclude 'NO EDIT NEEDED for decider — rule already in place at <file:line>.'
  (b) If the rule is implicit (e.g., decider's clone-fresh-each-run discipline is documented but no explicit clone-source-of-truth-for-FUSE rule is stated), add ONE LINE to monitor/prompts/decider.md or the most relevant reference doc: 'CRITICAL — clone is source-of-truth for monitor/decisions/* and monitor/analyst/*. Never read or write FUSE for these files; clone IS the canonical state.' Place near the existing clone-discipline section.
  (c) If the rule is contradicted anywhere (e.g., a reference doc says 'read from FUSE for X'), flag as Q_OP_for_operator with the contradiction quote.

Step 4 — Tinker self-applies both Step 2 (Part B) and Step 3 (decider audit + any one-line addition). Combined LOC budget: ~30 lines total across integrity + decider prompts. If scope grows beyond that, hold for operator review.

Step 5 — Validation:
  (a) For Part B: scan next 3 integrity commits after deploy for diff-line counts. A revert-shaped commit has high removal count (e.g., -130 +0); an append-only commit has low/zero removal. Document expected pattern in PROP's verification section.
  (b) For decider audit: verify the grep that the rule is present in decider's prompt surface (either pre-existing or newly added).

Step 6 — Lifecycle: flip new PROP-NNN.json status='implemented' with commit/at/run. Flip this directive to status='completed' with prop_id_implemented set. Flip PROP-077 status from 'implemented-partial' to 'implemented' (since Part B now ships) OR keep as 'implemented-partial' with a 'part_b_implemented_by' pointer to the new PROP — tinker's choice based on cleanest lineage.

Step 7 — Manually copy edited monitor/prompts/structure-integrity.md and (if changed) decider prompt files to FUSE. dome-mirror will propagate within ~30 min on its new :30 cron, but manual sync is the safe bootstrap path.
non_goals: Do NOT touch the workspace-sync.md Part A changes from PROP-077. Part A is shipped and stable; this directive is the Part B follow-up.
Do NOT broaden Q_OP_4 to analyst / analyst-baby / tinker prompt audits in this directive. Per operator decision: decider-only for now; revisit if recurrence shows up on other surfaces.
Do NOT tune RECENT_COMMIT_WINDOW_SEC (already decided in Q_OP_3 = 300s).
Do NOT revert the dome-mirror :30 cron (Q_OP_2 deferred until 2026-06-06 or later, separate decision then).
Do NOT modify decider's existing clone-discipline section — only add the one-liner if it's missing or implicit. Surgical addition, not restructure.

Do NOT auto-extend the clone-source-of-truth rule to monitor/curmudgeon/* or monitor/tinker/* in this run — those have different ownership patterns and the rule may not apply uniformly. Stay scoped to monitor/decisions/* + monitor/analyst/*.

priority_note: HIGH — the ACTUAL fix for the 2026-06-03 incident class. Part A was defense-in-depth; Part B is the structural fix. Worth shipping in the next 1-2 tinker runs to close the open recurrence risk.
